original_question: Let I be a radical ideal of big height e. Must the symbolic power containment I^(m) subset I^r hold whenever m >= re - (e - 1)?
target_in_paper: Section 2.8, Conjecture 2.8.1, in the subsection 'Bounds for symbolic powers' (Z. Teitler): Harbourne’s conjectural bound for symbolic-power containment of a radical ideal of big height e. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the exact containment direction, the parameter e as the big height, and the numerical threshold m ≥ re − (e − 1); this matches the bound stated in Conjecture 2.8.1. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
missing_details: The paper introduces the question in the geometric setting: X is a nonsingular variety of dimension n over the complex numbers, Z ⊆ X is a reduced subscheme, and I = I_Z ⊆ O_X is its ideal sheaf. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
It should state explicitly that e = bight(I), where bight(I) is the maximum codimension of a component of V(I). ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))

The quantifiers should be made explicit: the question is whether the containment holds for every positive integer r and every integer m satisfying m ≥ re − (e − 1), for every radical ideal/sheaf I of big height e in that setting. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))

To be fully stand-alone, I^(m) should be identified as the m-th symbolic power; in the paper’s setup it is the sheaf of germs vanishing to order at least m at each point of Z. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))

The paper does not impose homogeneity, grading, degree, variable-count, or nilpotency assumptions in Conjecture 2.8.1, so the refined question should not add any such restrictions. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))

The neighboring Harbourne–Huneke problem with an extra maximal-ideal factor, namely I^(m) ⊆ m^{re−r−(e−1)} I^r, is a different question (Problem 2.8.2(4)) and should not be folded into this one. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
refined_question: Let X be a nonsingular variety of dimension n over the complex numbers, let Z ⊆ X be a reduced subscheme with radical ideal sheaf I = I_Z ⊆ O_X, and let e = bight(I), the maximum codimension of a component of V(I). Is it true that for every positive integer r and every integer m ≥ re − (e − 1), the symbolic power I^(m) is contained in the ordinary power I^r? ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
justification: The draft is targeting Conjecture 2.8.1 exactly, not a broader neighboring problem: it asks for the plain containment I^(m) ⊆ I^r at the Harbourne threshold re − (e − 1), which is precisely the statement displayed as Conjecture 2.8.1 in Section 2.8. The surrounding paragraph supplies the ambient setup, the definition of symbolic powers, and the meaning of bight(I). Problem 2.8.2 on the next page is a distinct stronger variant with extra maximal-ideal factors, and Section 3.12 later returns to Conjecture 2.8.1 as the full-strength target beyond the weaker Takagi–Yoshida bound. ([impan.pl](https://www.impan.pl/~pragacz/bauer.pdf))
